name: dsh-memory-unlocked
description: Memory-unlocked(大记忆恢复术)— DeepSeek Harness plugin: recall earlier conversations. Two drill-down tools (recall_history + recall_expand, both carrying seq) plus an automatic `agent/pre-step` hook that fires on any of THREE trigger phrases (Memory unlocked, case-insensitive; 大记忆恢复术; DJYHFS). Every returned historical text is redacted and wrapped in a random-token data boundary, because history is untrusted input.
author: propzhang
